additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. NOT_APPLICABLE assessments concern the exact classification questions and do not authorise deleting supported source claims.

PRESERVES applies to the declared Boolean composition with adequately established, non-conflicting inputs. Neither representation implements exposure identification, aggregation, valuation, LAF categorisation or designation-history assessment.

Both representations state: "A conflicting fact anywhere in the rule dependency closure blocks evaluation with CONFLICT even on an unselected branch." This additional operational restriction can block an answer despite an independently established classification route. The circular does not prescribe that restriction; CONFLICT must not imply that classification is legally inapplicable.

Footnote 7 situates the holistic warranted-designation assessment below 50% of NAV. The OR formulas preserve outcomes for established threshold values because classification already follows automatically at or above 50%. They do not establish designation persistence, withdrawal or treatment of subsequent exposure changes.

The first candidate’s false_means phrase "neither aggregate exposure of at least 50% of NAV nor an operative SFC designation is established" could imply absence of evidence. The executable instead requires both route facts to be established FALSE; missing evidence remains UNKNOWN.

The designation-authority dispute reflects two assessment levels: the circular establishes the generic discretionary power, while applying a particular designation requires its decision and operative terms. NONE_DECLARED below addresses the generic claim; the missing decision evidence remains an explicit follow-up rather than an assumed negative fact.
All supplied external dependency IDs are unbound and have null source_hash values. None qualifies as AVAILABLE, and none can reliably be mapped to a named missing authority.

The separate LAF circular referenced in footnote 6 is absent. It is unnecessary to establish the express exclusion but may be needed for disputed categorisation. Applicable exposure updates, calculation guidance and designation temporal terms also remain unidentified; their necessity depends on the assessment facts.

No unsupported permission to sell or exemption from suitability appears in either formula. Compliance with the 15% limit, consultation and home-regulator conditions must not become additional classification prerequisites or automatic triggers.

The consultation statement preserves encouragement, but its OBLIGATION metadata could overstate the source if treated as mandatory. This extraction issue is not a demonstrated defect in the classification formulas.

The packet supplies no general effective-date or transition rule. A single-assessment-time formula does not establish historical applicability, reclassification procedures or overall distribution compliance.
